integrity: Analytic symmetric-cube and Gram-inverse proof with separate symbolic and occupation-basis numerical verification; no independent scientific validation
scientific_limitations: Exactly three noninteracting identical bosons, nonzero uniform hopping on a simple complete network, and local three-body loss at every site with strictly positive rates
No extension to arbitrary hopping, site disorder, two-body interactions, zero loss rates, or more than three initially present particles
Only eventual capture and the dark projector are classified; finite-time decay constants are not bounded
Historical priority is assessed on examined evidence; no exhaustive coverage or independent validation is claimed
title: Exact three-boson collision protection and a capture-order reversal on complete quantum networks
